prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd semester.
Programming course or proficiency in using at least one programming language.
Willingness and ability to learn the creative process of algorithm design and efficiency analysis using mathematical methods.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain basic concepts of programming and application languages.
They can explain typical characteristics of non-imperative languages.
They are able to develop simple grammars, type specifications and functional programs.
They are able to transfer practical experience in program development to new tasks.
They possess the ability to independently learn new programming and application languages.
Students know efficient data structures and algorithms for selected fundamental problems.
They are able to apply methods for correctness proof and efficiency analysis of algorithms and data structures.
They can independently and creatively develop algorithms and data structures.
They are able to apply mathematical methods for correctness proof and efficiency analysis.
They can explain the interaction between algorithm and data structure using essential examples.
They can assess the quality of algorithms and algorithmic approaches in terms of efficiency.
They can acquire new algorithms, data structures, and algorithmic ideas and analyses.

syllabus_topics: Side effects, programming without side effects
Evaluation of expressions and rules, unification
Limited but efficient evaluation in Datalog
Introduction: calculation models, efficiency measures, examples
Data structures: linked lists, trees, graphs, dynamic search trees, hashing, priority queues
Design and analysis methods: recursion and the master theorem, divide and conquer, dynamic programming, backtracking, branch & bound, greedy algorithms
Graph algorithms: Shortest paths, minimum spanning trees
Algorithms for the calculation of minimum span trees

assessment_methods.method: Programming assignment with subsequent discussion (Praktikum: Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen)

assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points occurs when the module partial examinations have been passed. The module is weighted by the number of its credit points (factor: 1).
